decisions.reason: A close-to-core illuminated arch line featured on the home page, in a growing industry, meets aspirations and gives no reason for problemistic search.
A traditional one-tier pyramid fits the firm's core craft offer, and such catalog staples tend to stay on the market for years.
Although distant from the core, the electronic music box line is presented as a flagship and was still prominent in 2019, so management will likely keep supporting it with available slack.
The motif platform got a second edition, which signals satisfactory demand, but as a distant, edition-based accessory it is at higher risk of being phased out.
The Christmas motif platform complements the flagship music box and suits the firm's seasonal business, though as a distant accessory it faces moderate drop risk.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds on the firm's established competence and was featured on the home page, which indicates satisfactory results.
